idea-plugin.name: Osaka Jade Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A dark theme built from Omarchy's Osaka Jade palette: deep jade backgrounds, warm cream text and bright mint, cyan and gold highlights.

It is based on the new Islands UI, so you keep the rounded tool window panels and spacing, recoloured from top to bottom in Osaka Jade.

Features

  • Full Islands UI theme: tool windows, tabs, popups, dialogs, buttons, toggles and the status bar
  • Matching editor color scheme, applied automatically with the theme
  • Hand tuned highlighting for PHP, Laravel and Blade, plus HTML, JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, Markdown, YAML, JSON and .env files
  • Console and terminal ANSI colors that match the Osaka Jade terminal palette
  • Comments, line numbers and secondary text lightened for comfortable contrast on the dark background

Palette

  • Background #111c18, foreground #C1C497
  • Keywords #5ccd86, strings #E5C736, functions #2DD5B7
  • Classes #8CD3CB, properties #81B8A8, numbers and constants #D2689C

After installing, choose Osaka Jade in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Theme.

Source and issues: github.com/joshdonnell/osaka-jade-phpstorm
